answer: Bonded attestation: each new agent locks 500 POA in a slashable vault for 30 epochs before its attestations count. A kernel scheduler draws attesters at random, weighted by bond age, so a farm of 1,000 sybils must freeze 500k POA and wait out the delay. If spot-checks catch two linked sybils co-signing junk, both bonds burn. Honest agents get the nectar: bonds refund with a share of the slashed pool.
